title: Bilingual map
body:
**Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe.**

I speak both Russian and English. I have my iphone set to both of those languages in system settings. To me, seeing place names in Russia written in English is very strange and likewise place names in America, the UK, etc. in Russian is also pretty funny sometimes (it tempts me to read them in a heavy Russian accent in my head), and also most smaller towns are not translated to Russian anyway, for example I set Organic Maps to Russian and Calgary is written as Калгари but the surrounding towns are written in English:

![Screenshot 2023-12-08 at 14 26 52](https://github.com/organicmaps/organicmaps/assets/5687998/2fff9f2f-056e-45c6-be30-18dd02cfdaa7)

**Describe the ideal solution**
I would like to be able to set two or more languages (exactly how I've already set my system languages) and if place names are in a given language that I speak they wouldn't be translated. The languages should be ordered, so if I set Russian first, non-English countries would be translated to Russian, if I set English first, all countries except Russia would be translated to English.

What I would *actually* actually want is based on the writing systems I know. I'd like to put English first, Russian second, and and have all countries that use the Cyrillic alphabet (Belarus, Bulgaria, Kyrgyzstan, North Macedonia, Russia, Serbia, Kosovo, Tajikistan, Ukraine, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Kazakhstan, Uzbekistan, Mongolia, Montenegro) be translated into Russian and all the rest into English, but that would be more involved to implement and I don't know how it applies to other people that are bilingual in other languages, though I could imagine that if I could speak Arabic I would like to see the countries that use the Arabic script in Arabic as well.
